# Put Me Down For: logo files

_16 Nov 2026. Final logo files made from the canvas sketches, after Zach confirmed the Blank and decided against an outside designer for now. This closes the "Logo files" item in `claude/BRAND.md` and `claude/BRAND_HANDOFF.md`. The rule the logo follows is in `claude/PALETTE.md`._

The full set (13 SVGs, 22 PNGs and `favicon.ico`) was sent to Zach as `PMDF-logo-files.zip` in the chat of 16 Nov. This doc holds the SVG source so the files can be rebuilt without that zip.

## How they are made

- **Letters:** Archivo at width 62, weight 800, converted to outlines. The SVGs contain paths, not text, so they need no font. Kerning is the font's own; letter spacing is 0.005 em.
- **The blank:** one stroked path after the last letter, 0.2 em away, 0.8 em wide, 0.085 em thick, round ends, its center 0.05 em under the baseline. It is a stroke, not an outline, so it keeps its round ends at any size.
- **Two lines:** baselines are 0.86 em apart.
- **Units:** 1000 per em.
- **Colors:** on light, letters Ink `#10121F` and the blank Pen on Paper `#0F766E`. On dark, letters Paper `#F4F3EE` and the blank Pen `#2DD4BF`. Icons are Ink with Paper letters and a Pen blank.

**To make the dark version of any SVG below,** replace `#10121F` with `#F4F3EE` and `#0F766E` with `#2DD4BF`.

## The files

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `pmdf-wordmark-on-light.svg` / `-on-dark.svg` | The full name on one line. The default logo everywhere outside the icon. |
| `pmdf-short-on-light.svg` / `-on-dark.svg` | `PMDF ___` on one line. Headers and tight spaces. |
| `pmdf-wordmark-stacked-on-light.svg` / `-on-dark.svg` | The full name on two lines. Square and tall layouts. |
| `pmdf-mark-on-light.svg` / `-on-dark.svg` | PM over DF with the blank, no background. |
| `pmdf-icon.svg` | The app icon: a full square of Ink, the mark at 74% of the width. The platform rounds the corners. |
| `pmdf-icon-maskable.svg` | The same with the mark at 56%, so it survives Android's circle and squircle masks. |
| `pmdf-icon-rounded.svg` | The icon with its own rounded corners, for places that don't mask it (web pages, the favicon). |
| `pmdf-icon-light.svg` | A white version of the icon. |
| `option-favicon-p.svg` | **An option, not adopted:** a single P and the blank. See "Favicon" below. |

PNG exports in the zip:

| File | Size | Goes where |
|---|---|---|
| `icon-192.png`, `icon-512.png` | 192, 512 | Web app manifest, purpose `any` |
| `icon-maskable-192.png`, `icon-maskable-512.png` | 192, 512 | Web app manifest, purpose `maskable` |
| `apple-touch-icon.png` | 180 | iPhone home screen |
| `favicon.ico` | 16, 32, 48 | Browser tab |
| `icon-1024.png` | 1024 | Master; social profile pictures |
| Logos | 1000 to 2400 wide, transparent | Email header, website, documents |

## Wiring them into the app (not done; for the rename)

The app is Next.js with `src/app`. Nobody has looked at what icon files the repo holds today, so check before replacing.

- `src/app/favicon.ico`, `src/app/icon.svg` (use `pmdf-icon-rounded.svg`) and `src/app/apple-icon.png` (use `apple-touch-icon.png`) are picked up by Next.js by file name.
- The manifest icons go in `public/icons/` and are listed in the manifest:

```json
{
  "name": "Put Me Down For",
  "short_name": "PMDF",
  "display": "standalone",
  "background_color": "#10121F",
  "theme_color": "#10121F",
  "icons": [
    { "src": "/icons/icon-192.png", "sizes": "192x192", "type": "image/png" },
    { "src": "/icons/icon-512.png", "sizes": "512x512", "type": "image/png" },
    { "src": "/icons/icon-maskable-192.png", "sizes": "192x192", "type": "image/png", "purpose": "maskable" },
    { "src": "/icons/icon-maskable-512.png", "sizes": "512x512", "type": "image/png", "purpose": "maskable" }
  ]
}
```

## Favicon: one decision for Zach

At 32 pixels the PM over DF icon is readable. At 16 pixels, which is a browser tab on a screen that isn't high-density, the four letters blur. `option-favicon-p.svg` is a single P with the blank; it stays clear at 16. It is a new variant Zach has not seen in use, so it is included as an option only. `favicon.ico` in the zip is built from the full icon.

## Known limits

- Archivo and Caveat Brush are free fonts under the SIL Open Font License. The letterforms are not exclusive to this brand.
- No animated logo file exists. The opening motion is described in `claude/PALETTE.md` and shown on the canvas and in the marketing videos.
- The handwritten answers are not part of these files. They are set live in Caveat Brush.
